decisions.statement: A tier a character is not eligible for gives that character nothing.
What a character already holds counts towards that character's own target first.
No character both deposits and withdraws one stocked item.
A tier takes up to the count the tier names.
The items one tier leaves over are offered to the tier below.
The items the last tier leaves over are threaded on to the next rule.

definition: one rule's items spread down a chain of destinations, tier by tier
